integrity: Eight-term factorizations explicitly included; all bilinear products and every seven-form obstruction checked by exact finite-field arithmetic using embedded source. General equivalence of evolution envelopes and symmetric tensor decompositions proved directly.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for K=F_2 or F_3 and algebra K[t]/(t^4); no claim on other fields, truncation lengths, uniqueness of envelopes or ordinary nonsymmetric multiplication-tensor rank. Primary-source Remark 5.4 gives only a strict lower bound over F_3; an unindexed identical construction remains possible.
title: Exact minimal evolution-envelope dimension of the fourth truncated polynomial algebra over \(\mathbb F_2\) and \(\mathbb F_3\)
